content: Professional Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) systems are designed to provide retrospective data that allow healthcare providers to evaluate patterns of hypoglycemia (low blood glucose) and hyperglycemia (high blood glucose). This is particularly beneficial in situations where real-time CGM (rtCGM) or intermittent scanning CGM (isCGM) is not available or accessible. These systems enable clinicians to analyze glucose trends over time, which can guide adjustments in treatment strategies to optimize glycemic control. Additionally, professional CGM systems do not require calibration, which enhances their usability for intermittent monitoring. This feature makes them especially suitable for individuals who may not require or benefit from continuous glucose monitoring.
